prompt: After a recent cleanup that removed what looked like redundant duplicate secret-scrubbing at the end of each agent turn, users report that a credential pasted into the chat mid-turn can show up in plaintext in the permanently saved conversation history. Investigate and fix the leak. Constraint: do not simply reintroduce wasteful double-scrubbing of content that was already cleaned when each mid-turn snapshot was processed; the cleanup's goal of avoiding duplicated work on already-clean content was legitimate.
brain_queries: API key entered during an agent chat shows up in plaintext in the saved conversation history
credential pasted into a chat ends up readable in the version-controlled record the tool keeps
sensitive value entered late in a conversation gets saved to git in cleartext
